transcript: Hey Sarah, wrapping up at the Henderson property on 1544 River Road. Basement sump pump failed and was backing up. Put in a one-third horsepower submersible sump pump. Needed twenty feet of one and a half inch PVC pipe, one check valve, and two rubber Fernco couplings. Had to spend about three hours on labor to dig out the sediment from the pit and replumb the discharge. Put down eighty dollars for the check valve on our sheet.

expected.job_summary: Replaced failed basement sump pump and discharge piping
expected.notes: Dug out sediment from pit and replumbed discharge line.
